name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
description: Safe motherhood intervention under National Health Mission promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women, with conditional cash assistance to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women delivering in public health institutions or accredited private health facilities
benefits: Direct cash assistance: Rs. 1,400 in rural areas and Rs. 1,000 in urban areas for mothers delivering in public health facilities in Low Performing States (LPS); Rs. 700 in rural and Rs. 600 in urban areas for BPL/SC/ST mothers in High Performing States (HPS).

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India under National Health Mission.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Centrally sponsored health intervention operational across all States and UTs with special focus on 10 Low Performing States.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

source_evidence.statement: All pregnant women delivering in government health facilities in LPS, and BPL/SC/ST pregnant women in HPS aged 19 years and above.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Cash assistance up to Rs. 1,400 for institutional delivery plus ASHA incentive for mobilization and escort services.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Official NHM guidelines and maternal health portal hosted at nhm.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Integrated with Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan (SUMAN) ensuring zero expense delivery in public hospitals.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Institutional delivery must occur in an accredited health institution (PHC, CHC, District Hospital or accredited private hospital).

required_documents.title: Institutional Delivery Discharge Slip
required_documents.description: Discharge summary or delivery certificate issued by the public hospital or accredited medical facility.

required_documents.title: Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Individual savings bank account for direct DBT transfer.
